Volume
Compared to the last report, all grades of hay firm. Exporters especially China re-entering the market and domestic buyers with orders from 
Florida are active. Trade remains moderate to active with good demand.
Please Note: The above volumes (tonnage, acres, and bales) listed on this USDA LPGMN report are for confirmed trades only, it does not 
include estimated volume (tonnage) for bids or offers to the trade.
